author: Y Combinator
description:
In this talk and fireside at Startup School 2026, Legora Co-founder and CEO Max Junestrand reflects on lessons learned while building a legal product that is now used across 50 countries and went from $1 million to $100 million ARR in roughly 18 months. 

Apply to Y Combinator: https://www.ycombinator.com/apply
Work at a startup: https://www.ycombinator.com/jobs
